title: Find Baseline Wander
story: The test rig added a linear trend. Estimate it from known calibration endpoints.
lesson: A line between first and last samples has slope (last-first)/(n-1). This toy exercise assumes endpoints contain only baseline.
objective: Return the linearly interpolated baseline across the input length. Empty -> []; one sample -> that sample.
hint: Treat lengths zero and one separately, then interpolate between endpoints.
